experience.description: Help clients by providing solutions that foster growth and efficiency through Data Engineering and Architecture services. Worked with various clients including MTSU Data Science Institute, Concert Genetics, Verana Health, and Picknic.

Worked on building an ingestion platform that pulls in data from Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and processes them into a common data model. Built PySpark Data Quality modules, AWS Glue PySpark jobs, and application templates.

Started as Data Services Manager leading Data Engineering and Data Science teams, then transitioned to Principal Machine Learning Engineer. Established source control strategy, developed team members, provided technical guidance, and implemented data optimization solutions.

Worked on Data Operations team managing data intake and processing, then transferred to Data Science team focusing on streamlining model development, deployment, and management. Improved development efficiency and deployment processes.

Supported analytic groups through developing data pipelines, warehousing data, and maintaining reporting solutions. Developed scheduled data pipelines using Talend and supported self-service analytics.
Supported development, testing, and troubleshooting of software products. Optimized SQL reports, documented software issues, and provided technical support to customers.
Worked as an analyst supporting PATRIOT System Effectiveness Model (PSEM). Automated evaluation processes, developed automation scripts, and performed Verification and Validation activities.
